scientific_integrity: The proof includes the exact Fourier density, the complete sign argument including boundary, and a standalone exact polynomial and numeric quadrature checker. Earliest day-resolved archival background source is arXiv:1111.7077v1 (2011-11-30); the 2006 book background has no verified first-public day, so no day is inferred from its year.
scientific_limitations: Classification is exact for the isotropic Euclidean three-dimensional Matérn smoothness-3/2 envelope multiplied by cos(omega r); the unrestricted one-dimensional comparison is also exact. No classification of other dimensions or Matérn orders is asserted. A bounded primary-literature search cannot establish global novelty. No independent validation was performed.
title: A sharp three-dimensional admissibility boundary for radially modulated Matérn kernels
